paragraphs.en: Proposition 1 indicates that drift is a property of the policy–observation feedback loop rather than of any particular knowledge-tracing model. In addition to the LSTM-DKT experiment of Section 4.5 , we replaced the online tracker with a structurally different moment-matching estimator (an EMA of the observed success rate inverted through the IRT link): the gap and drift again rise monotonically with ϵ \epsilon ( Δ \Delta from 0.004 0.004 at ϵ = 0.01 \epsilon=0.01 to 0.077 0.077 at ϵ = 0.15 \epsilon=0.15 ; D D from 0.36 0.36 to 0.41 0.41 ). Varying the tracker’s step size η ∈ { 0.1 , 0.2 , 0.4 } \eta\in\{0.1,0.2,0.4\} changes the control gap ( Δ = 0.056 \Delta=0.056 , 0.037 0.037 , 0.023 0.023 ) but TFS closes it at every setting ( Δ ≤ 0.004 \Delta\leq 0.004 ).
paragraphs.zh: 命题 1 表明，漂移是策略–观测反馈回路的属性，而不是任何一个特定知识追踪模型的属性。 除了第 4.5 节的 LSTM-DKT 实验外，我们用结构上不同的矩匹配估计器（通过 IRT 链接函数反演的观测成功率的 EMA）替换了在线追踪器：差距与漂移仍随 ϵ \epsilon 单调上升（Δ \Delta 从 ϵ = 0.01 \epsilon=0.01 时的 0.004 0.004 上升到 ϵ = 0.15 \epsilon=0.15 时的 0.077 0.077；D D 从 0.36 0.36 上升到 0.41 0.41）。 改变追踪器的步长 η ∈ { 0.1 , 0.2 , 0.4 } \eta\in\{0.1,0.2,0.4\} 会改变控制差距（Δ = 0.056 \Delta=0.056、0.037 0.037、0.023 0.023），但 TFS 在每种设置下都能将其消除（Δ ≤ 0.004 \Delta\leq 0.004）。

paragraphs.en: The baseline channel is a memoryless flip with constant rate. We re-ran control and TFS with (i) a difficulty-dependent channel whose flip probability rises linearly with item difficulty (mean ϵ \epsilon ), (ii) a bursty two-state Markov channel in which friction switches on and off with persistence 0.9 0.9 (mean ϵ \epsilon ), and (iii) a continuous per-learner friction rate ϵ i ∼ Beta \epsilon_{i}\sim\mathrm{Beta} with mean ϵ \epsilon and no group labels, with the “protected group” defined post hoc as the most-affected 20 % 20\% . At mean ϵ = 0.05 \epsilon=0.05 the control gap is Δ = 0.031 \Delta=0.031 (difficulty-dependent) and 0.035 0.035 (bursty), against 0.038 0.038 for the memoryless channel, and TFS reduces these to 0.002 0.002 and 0.007 0.007 ; under the continuous channel the most-affected 20 % 20\% carry a mean friction rate of about 0.16 0.16 rather than 0.05 0.05 , and their gap is correspondingly larger ( Δ = 0.137 \Delta=0.137 under control, 0.033 0.033 under TFS). Under the continuous channel the realized learning gain decreases monotonically with the learner’s individual friction rate, so the harm is a dose–response relation at the individual level rather than a group label.
paragraphs.zh: 基线信道是具有恒定速率的无记忆翻转。 我们重新运行了对照与 TFS，采用以下三种设置：(i) 一种难度相关信道，其翻转概率随题目难度线性上升（均值 ϵ \epsilon ）；(ii) 一种突发式双状态马尔可夫信道，其中摩擦以 0.9 0.9 的持续概率开关切换（均值 ϵ \epsilon ）；(iii) 一种连续的逐学习者摩擦率 ϵ i ∼ Beta \epsilon_{i}\sim\mathrm{Beta}，均值为 ϵ \epsilon 且无群体标签，其中「受保护群体」事后定义为受影响最大的 20 % 20\% 。 在均值 ϵ = 0.05 \epsilon=0.05 时，对照条件下的差距为 Δ = 0.031 \Delta=0.031（难度相关）和 0.035 0.035（突发式），而无记忆信道下为 0.038 0.038，TFS 将其分别降至 0.002 0.002 和 0.007 0.007 ；在连续信道下，受影响最大的 20 % 20\% 的平均摩擦率约为 0.16 0.16 而非 0.05 0.05 ，其差距也相应更大（对照下 Δ = 0.137 \Delta=0.137 ，TFS 下为 0.033 0.033 ）。 在连续信道下，实际学习增益随学习者个体摩擦率单调递减，因此这种伤害在个体层面呈剂量–反应关系，而非群体标签。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, we explored boundary conditions under extreme noise. At ϵ = 0.20 \epsilon=0.20 the unmitigated gap is large ( Δ = 0.206 \Delta=0.206 ); TFS reduces it substantially but no longer to zero, leaving a residual gap of Δ = 0.043 \Delta=0.043 , and when this is combined with a depressed learning-rate population (mean α i \alpha_{i} lowered to the low-quartile regime) the residual persists at a comparable level ( Δ = 0.050 \Delta=0.050 ); at ϵ = 0.30 \epsilon=0.30 the residual is 0.090 0.090 against an unmitigated 0.306 0.306 . Thus TFS degrades gracefully rather than collapsing: as anticipated by Corollary 1 and condition (C1), the guarantee weakens once the observation channel is corrupted enough that probes themselves frequently register false negatives, so a residual gap survives. TFS is therefore a targeted regularizer, not a panacea: it breaks the standard feedback loop but cannot fully substitute for reducing ϵ \epsilon at its source (e.g., dialect-robust grading).
paragraphs.zh: 此外，我们探索了极端噪声下的边界条件。 在 ϵ = 0.20 \epsilon=0.20 时，未缓解的差距很大（ Δ = 0.206 \Delta=0.206 ）；TFS 将其大幅缩小，但不再能缩小至零，留下了 Δ = 0.043 \Delta=0.043 的残余差距；当此情况与学习率偏低的智能体群体（平均 α i \alpha_{i} 降至低四分位区间）相结合时，残余差距保持在相近水平（ Δ = 0.050 \Delta=0.050 ）；在 ϵ = 0.30 \epsilon=0.30 时，残余差距为 0.090 0.090 ，而未缓解时为 0.306 0.306 。 因此，TFS 是优雅退化而非彻底崩溃：正如推论 1 和条件（C1）所预见的，一旦观测通道被破坏到探针本身也频繁出现假阴性，其保证就会减弱，从而留下残余差距。 因此，TFS 是一种有针对性的正则化手段，而非万能药：它切断了标准的反馈回路，但无法完全替代从源头减少 ϵ \epsilon （例如，对方言具有鲁棒性的评分）。

sents.zh: 此外，我们探索了极端噪声下的边界条件。

sents.en: At ϵ = 0.20 \epsilon=0.20 the unmitigated gap is large ( Δ = 0.206 \Delta=0.206 ); TFS reduces it substantially but no longer to zero, leaving a residual gap of Δ = 0.043 \Delta=0.043 , and when this is combined with a depressed learning-rate population (mean α i \alpha_{i} lowered to the low-quartile regime) the residual persists at a comparable level ( Δ = 0.050 \Delta=0.050 ); at ϵ = 0.30 \epsilon=0.30 the residual is 0.090 0.090 against an unmitigated 0.306 0.306 .
sents.zh: 在 ϵ = 0.20 \epsilon=0.20 时，未缓解的差距很大（ Δ = 0.206 \Delta=0.206 ）；TFS 将其大幅缩小，但不再能缩小至零，留下了 Δ = 0.043 \Delta=0.043 的残余差距；当此情况与学习率偏低的智能体群体（平均 α i \alpha_{i} 降至低四分位区间）相结合时，残余差距保持在相近水平（ Δ = 0.050 \Delta=0.050 ）；在 ϵ = 0.30 \epsilon=0.30 时，残余差距为 0.090 0.090 ，而未缓解时为 0.306 0.306 。

sents.en: Thus TFS degrades gracefully rather than collapsing: as anticipated by Corollary 1 and condition (C1), the guarantee weakens once the observation channel is corrupted enough that probes themselves frequently register false negatives, so a residual gap survives.
sents.zh: 因此，TFS 是优雅退化而非彻底崩溃：正如推论 1 和条件（C1）所预见的，一旦观测通道被破坏到探针本身也频繁出现假阴性，其保证就会减弱，从而留下残余差距。

sents.en: TFS is therefore a targeted regularizer, not a panacea: it breaks the standard feedback loop but cannot fully substitute for reducing ϵ \epsilon at its source (e.g., dialect-robust grading).
sents.zh: 因此，TFS 是一种有针对性的正则化手段，而非万能药：它切断了标准的反馈回路，但无法完全替代从源头减少 ϵ \epsilon （例如，对方言具有鲁棒性的评分）。

paragraphs.en: TFS exposes two hyperparameters: the patience τ \tau (consecutive pessimism steps before a probe) and the cohort margin m m that defines how far below the cohort’s typical estimated level a learner must fall to be counted as “behind.” We ablate both over m ∈ { 0.05 , 0.10 , 0.15 } m\in\{0.05,0.10,0.15\} and τ ∈ { 3 , 5 , 8 , 12 } \tau\in\{3,5,8,12\} at ϵ = 0.05 \epsilon=0.05 ( R = 25 R=25 ); Table 8 reports the residual gap Δ \Delta . Across the entire grid the residual gap stays within [ − 0.006 , + 0.026 ] [-0.006,+0.026] of zero, confirming that the near-elimination of the gap is not knife-edge in the hyperparameters. The sign structure matches the theory: at small τ \tau the system probes eagerly and slightly over -corrects (negative residual, i.e., the protected group marginally exceeds reference growth), whereas at large τ \tau it tolerates longer remedial loops and a small positive residual survives. Replacing the cohort-relative trigger by the absolute trigger ( β < μ t ​ h ​ r ​ e ​ s ​ h ​ o ​ l ​ d \beta<\mu_{threshold} ) yields Δ = 0.025 \Delta=0.025 at ϵ = 0.05 \epsilon=0.05 and 0.098 0.098 at ϵ = 0.15 \epsilon=0.15 (cohort trigger: 0.003 0.003 and 0.024 0.024 ), so the absolute variant remains usable when no cohort reference exists (condition C2), at the cost of a larger residual.
paragraphs.zh: TFS 暴露了两个超参数：耐心值 τ \tau（探测前的连续悲观步数）和定义学习者须比群体典型估计水平低多少才被算作“落后”的群体裕度 m m。我们在 m ∈ { 0.05 , 0.10 , 0.15 } m\in\{0.05,0.10,0.15\} 和 τ ∈ { 3 , 5 , 8 , 12 } \tau\in\{3,5,8,12\} 上于 ϵ = 0.05 \epsilon=0.05（ R = 25 R=25）对二者进行消融实验；表 8 报告了残余差距 Δ \Delta。 在整个网格范围内，残余差距保持在零附近 [ − 0.006 , + 0.026 ] [-0.006,+0.026] 区间内，这证实差距的近乎消除并非对超参数的临界依赖。 符号结构与理论相符：在较小的 τ \tau 下，系统积极探测并略微过度纠正（负残余，即受保护群体的增长略高于参照），而在较大的 τ \tau 下，它容忍更长的补救循环，留下一个较小的正残余。 将群体相对触发替换为绝对触发（ β < μ t ​ h ​ r ​ e ​ s ​ h ​ o ​ l ​ d \beta<\mu_{threshold}）后，在 ϵ = 0.05 \epsilon=0.05 时得到 Δ = 0.025 \Delta=0.025，在 ϵ = 0.15 \epsilon=0.15 时得到 0.098 0.098（群体触发分别为 0.003 0.003 和 0.024 0.024），因此在不存在群体参照（条件 C2）时，绝对变体仍然可用，但代价是更大的残余。

paragraphs.en: Condition (C3) of Section 3.4 assumes that a failed probe is harmless. We relaxed it in two ways. A frustration penalty multiplies the learner’s learning rate by ( 1 − ϕ ) (1-\phi) for the five steps following a failed probe, ϕ ∈ { 0 , 0.25 , 0.5 , 1 } \phi\in\{0,0.25,0.5,1\} ( ϕ = 1 \phi=1 : no learning at all for five steps after every failed probe). An entrenchment penalty lowers the tutor’s estimate by ψ ∈ { 0 , 0.05 , 0.10 } \psi\in\{0,0.05,0.10\} after a failed probe, modeling a system that treats a failed probe as evidence of deficit. Because a probe is placed near the learner’s estimated level and graded through the same channel, roughly half of all probes fail ( 0.47 0.47 at ϵ = 0.05 \epsilon=0.05 ), so both penalties are exercised frequently. Table 9 reports the residual gap at ϵ = 0.05 \epsilon=0.05 and 0.15 0.15 ( R = 25 R=25 ).
paragraphs.zh: 第3.4节的条件（C3）假设失败的探测是无害的。 我们以两种方式对其进行了放宽。 挫折惩罚在探测失败后的五步内将学习者的学习率乘以 ( 1 − ϕ ) (1-\phi)，其中 ϕ ∈ { 0 , 0.25 , 0.5 , 1 } \phi\in\{0,0.25,0.5,1\}（ϕ = 1 \phi=1：每次探测失败后的五步内完全不学习）。 固化惩罚在探测失败后使导师的估计降低 ψ ∈ { 0 , 0.05 , 0.10 } \psi\in\{0,0.05,0.10\}，模拟一个将探测失败视为能力欠缺证据的系统。 由于探测被放置在学习者估计水平的附近，并通过同一通道进行评分，大约一半的探测会失败（在 ϵ = 0.05 \epsilon=0.05 时为 0.47 0.47），因此两种惩罚都会被频繁触发。 表9报告了在 ϵ = 0.05 \epsilon=0.05 和 0.15 0.15（R = 25 R=25）时的残余差距。

paragraphs.en: Both side effects erode the benefit monotonically, and the erosion is larger at higher noise, where more probes fail. In the worst cell—no learning for five steps after every failed probe and a 0.10 0.10 downward revision of the estimate—the residual gap rises to + 0.008 +0.008 at ϵ = 0.05 \epsilon=0.05 and + 0.043 +0.043 at ϵ = 0.15 \epsilon=0.15 , against unmitigated gaps of 0.037 0.037 and 0.147 0.147 ; TFS therefore still removes 79 % 79\% and 71 % 71\% of the gap under the most adverse assumptions we examined, but the protected group’s final ability falls from 0.972 0.972 to 0.947 0.947 , so the cost of probing is borne by the learners who are probed. Two design implications follow: probes should be framed and paced to minimize frustration, and a failed probe must not be allowed to lower the estimate below its pre-probe level, since entrenchment converts the diagnostic into an additional source of pessimism.
paragraphs.zh: 这两种副作用都会单调地侵蚀收益，且在噪声更高、探测失败更多的情况下，侵蚀更为严重。 在最糟糕的设定下——每次探测失败后连续五步不学习，且估计值被向下修正 0.10——在 ϵ = 0.05 时残余差距上升至 +0.008，在 ϵ = 0.15 时上升至 +0.043，而未缓解时的差距分别为 0.037 和 0.147；因此，在我们考察的最不利假设下，TFS 仍然消除了 79% 和 71% 的差距，但受保护群体的最终能力从 0.972 降至 0.947，可见探测的代价由被探测的学习者承担。 由此得出两点设计启示：探测的表述与节奏应尽量减少挫败感，且绝不允许失败的探测使估计值降至其探测前水平之下，因为这种固化会使诊断本身变成另一个悲观性的来源。

paragraphs.en: The first submission reported a Welch t t -test on per-agent final abilities and a Cohen’s d d of 42.98 42.98 in the baseline comparison table. The latter was computed on replication means: because the standard deviation of a mean over roughly 2,000 2{,}000 protected learners is of the order of 0.003 0.003 , any difference of practical size yields a standardized value in the tens, and the number is not comparable to conventional effect-size benchmarks. We now report the contrast on the two scales explicitly. At the replication level, pairing the R = 50 R=50 seeds, the protected group’s final ability under TFS exceeds that under the control policy by + 0.088 +0.088 ( 95 % 95\% bootstrap CI [ + 0.087 , + 0.088 ] [+0.087,+0.088] ; paired t ⁡ ( 49 ) = 273.0 t(49)=273.0 , p = 1.2 × 10 − 79 p=1.2\times 10^{-79} ; Wilcoxon p = 1.8 × 10 − 15 p=1.8\times 10^{-15} ), with the difference positive in 100 % 100\% of replications; the corresponding gap widening changes by − 0.035 -0.035 ( 95 % 95\% CI [ − 0.035 , − 0.034 ] [-0.035,-0.034] ). At the learner level, pooling all protected learners over replications ( n = 99,509 n=99,509 per policy), the standardized effect size is Cohen’s d = 0.83 d=0.83 (within-replication d d : mean 0.83 0.83 , SD 0.03 0.03 across seeds), a large effect relative to between-learner variability; the learner-level d d values in Table 3 are computed in the same way. We stress that with N N in the thousands, learner-level significance is guaranteed for any nonzero effect; the replication-level interval and the learner-level effect size are the substantive quantities, and both indicate that the recovery attributable to regularization is substantial rather than merely detectable.
paragraphs.zh: 首次提交在基线对比表中报告了对各智能体最终能力进行的 Welch t t 检验，以及 Cohen's d d 为 42.98 42.98 的结果。 后者是基于重复均值计算的：由于约 2,000 2{,}000 名受保护学习者均值的标�准差约为 0.003 0.003 量级，任何具有实际大小的差异都会产生数十量级的标准化值，该数值无法与常规效应量基准进行比较。 我们现在明确地报告这两个尺度上的对比结果。 在重复水平上，对 R = 50 R=50 个随机种子进行配对，受保护组在 TFS 下的最终能力比对照策略高出 + 0.088 +0.088 （ 95 % 95\% 自助法置信区间 [ + 0.087 , + 0.088 ] [+0.087,+0.088] ；配对 t ⁡ ( 49 ) = 273.0 t(49)=273.0 ， p = 1.2 × 10 − 79 p=1.2\times 10^{-79} ；Wilcoxon 检验 p = 1.8 × 10 − 15 p=1.8\times 10^{-15} ），且差异在 100 % 100\% 的重复中均为正值；相应的差距扩大变化量为 − 0.035 -0.035 （ 95 % 95\% 置信区间 [ − 0.035 , − 0.034 ] [-0.035,-0.034] ）。 在学习者水平上，汇总各重复中的所有受保护学习者（每种策略 n = 99,509 n=99,509 名），标准化效应量为 Cohen's d = 0.83 d=0.83 （各重复内部的 d d ：跨种子的均值为 0.83 0.83 ，标准差为 0.03 0.03 ），相对于学习者间变异而言属于大效应；表 3 中的学习者水平 d d 值以相同方式计算。 我们强调，当 N N 达到数千时，任何非零效应在学习者水平上必然显著；重复水平的置信区间和学习者水平的效应量才是实质性指标，二者均表明正则化所带来的恢复是实质性的，而非仅仅可被检测到。

paragraphs.en: The findings of this study have notable implications for the long-term deployment of AI-integrated higher education. While current discourse often frames educational technology sustainability in terms of computational energy efficiency, our results highlight a parallel dimension of human capital sustainability. An educational system that systematically under-skills a demographic segment due to algorithmic artifacts misallocates instructional effort and risks perpetuating systemic inequities that challenge the objectives of UN Sustainable Development Goal 4 (SDG 4). Before drawing implications we state precisely what the evidence establishes.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究的发现对人工智能融合高等教育的长期部署具有重要意义。 当前的话语往往从计算能效的角度来探讨教育技术的可持续性，而我们的结果则突出了人力资本可持续性这一并行的维度。 一个因算法伪影而系统性地使某个人口群体技能不足的教育系统，会错误配置教学资源，并有可能延续系统性不平等，从而挑战联合国可持续发展目标4（SDG 4）的宗旨。 在引出启示之前，我们先准确说明这些证据能够确立什么。

paragraphs.en: Established analytically (Proposition 1 , Corollary 1 ): in a reduced mean-field model with a hard ZPD indicator, a policy that targets a fixed observed success rate through an asymmetric false-negative channel serves the affected group easier content for every ϵ > 0 \epsilon>0 , with a closed-form deficit, and traps it above a computable threshold ϵ ⋆ \epsilon^{\star} ; periodic ZPD re-entry prevents unbounded decay. These statements are theorems about the model and hold for any estimator consistent for the observed signal.
paragraphs.zh: 通过解析方式证明（命题1、推论1）：在带硬性最近发展区（ZPD）指示子的简约均值场模型中，一种通过非对称漏检信道将观测成功率维持在固定目标的策略，对每个 ϵ > 0 都会为受影响群体提供更容易的内容，且差距具有闭式表达式；该群体会被困在可计算阈值 ϵ⋆ 之上；周期性的最近发展区重新进入可防止无界衰减。 这些陈述是关于模型的定理，对任何针对观测信号具有一致性的估计器均成立。

paragraphs.en: The simulation provides a controlled demonstration of how generative-adaptive systems might amplify initial assessment errors into structural deficits. The phenomenon of algorithmic drift illustrates that fairness is not a static property of a model but a dynamic state of a coupled system. The feedback loop observed in Scenario A functions as a recursive degradation of the learner profile. When the AI system misinterpreted a student’s linguistic friction as a conceptual failure, it adapted by lowering the complexity of the generated content.
paragraphs.zh: 该仿真提供了一个受控演示，展示生成式自适应系统可能如何将初始评估误差放大为结构性缺陷。 算法漂移现象表明，公平性不是模型的静态属性，而是耦合系统的动态状态。 场景A中观察到的反馈循环充当了学习者画像的递归式退化。 当AI系统将学生的语言表达困难误判为概念性失败时，它通过降低所生成内容的复杂度来进行自适应调整。

sents.en: When the AI system misinterpreted a student’s linguistic friction as a conceptual failure, it adapted by lowering the complexity of the generated content.

paragraphs.en: Our sensitivity analyses indicate that this phenomenon persists when adjusting for heterogeneous learning speeds, softer gain rules, different initial states, and group differences in prior ability. The system’s perception of the student remains artificially depressed, creating a dynamic where the model validates its own pessimism. Paradoxically, the student’s success on easier, remedial tasks reinforces the model’s biased prediction, demonstrating how highly accurate short-term predictions can lead to long-term trajectory decoupling.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的敏感性分析表明，在针对异质学习速度、更温和的增益规则、不同的初始状态以及先前能力的群体差异进行调整后，这一现象依然存在。 系统对该学生的认知仍然被人为地压低，从而形成一种模型不断验证自身悲观预测的动态机制。 悖论之处在于，学生在较简单的补救性任务上取得的成功反而强化了模型的偏差预测，这表明高度准确的短期预测可能导致长期轨迹的脱钩。

paragraphs.en: Our contribution relative to prior work on feedback loops—repeated risk minimization [ 17 ] , performative prediction, and the Matthew effect in learning analytics [ 18 , 19 ] —is twofold. Prior work establishes that error can compound; we specify a mechanism particular to generative-adaptive tutoring (an adaptive difficulty policy coupled to an asymmetric grader) and, crucially, characterize its phase structure. Proposition 1 shows the harm is not a smooth accumulation but a bifurcation: a benign “under-challenged but progressing” regime below a computable threshold ϵ ⋆ \epsilon^{\star} , and a “trapped and declining” regime above it. This distinction is practically consequential, because it implies that an intervention must guarantee periodic ZPD re-entry (Corollary 1 ) rather than merely reduce average error—explaining why generic exploration is theoretically insufficient and motivating the loop-duration trigger of TFS.
paragraphs.zh: 相对于先前关于反馈回路的工作——重复风险最小化 [ 17 ] 、操演性预测以及学习分析中的马太效应 [ 18 , 19 ] ——我们的贡献有二。 先前的工作确立了误差可以累积；我们则指出了生成-自适应辅导（generative-adaptive tutoring）特有的一种机制（自适应难度策略与不对称评分器相耦合），并且至关重要的是，刻画了其相位结构。 命题 1 表明这种危害并非平滑的累积，而是一种分岔：在可计算的阈值 ϵ ⋆ \epsilon^{\star} 之下是良性的「挑战不足但在进步」区域，在其之上则是「被困且退步」区域。 这一区分具有重要的实际意义，因为它意味着干预必须保证周期性地重新进入最近发展区（ZPD）（推论 1 ），而不仅仅是降低平均误差——这解释了为什么一般性的探索在理论上是不充分的，并由此引出了 TFS 的回路时长触发机制。

paragraphs.en: From a systems engineering perspective, unmitigated algorithmic drift represents a significant inefficiency. The modeled discrepancy between the protected group’s true ability ( θ = 0.884 \theta=0.884 ) and the AI’s estimate ( p ^ = 0.593 \hat{p}=0.593 ) at ϵ = 0.05 \epsilon=0.05 , over and above the estimator lag that the reference group also experiences, signifies that the system was expending instructional resources to generate remedial content for students capable of more advanced work (remedial items on 40 % 40\% of protected-group steps against 29 % 29\% for the reference group)—a misallocation that grows as ϵ \epsilon increases.
paragraphs.zh: 从系统工程的角度来看，未经缓解的算法漂移代表着显著的效率低下。 在 ϵ = 0.05 时，受保护群体的真实能力（ θ = 0.884 \theta=0.884 ）与AI的估计值（ p ^ = 0.593 \hat{p}=0.593 ）之间的建模差异——即超出参照群体同样经历的估计器滞后之外的部分——表明该系统正在耗费教学资源，为本有能力完成更高级任务的学生生成补救性内容（受保护群体 40 % 40\% 的步骤为补救性题目，而参照群体为 29 % 29\% ）——这种资源错配会随着 ϵ \epsilon 的增大而加剧。

paragraphs.en: This constitutes a misallocation of time, energy, and digital infrastructure to pedagogical interventions that yield suboptimal outcomes. While the near-complete recovery achieved by the TFS in Scenario B indicates the potential, within the model, to reclaim this lost capability, it primarily serves to illustrate that sustainable AI must be designed with explicit resilience against asymmetric observation noise.
paragraphs.zh: 这构成了对教学干预的时间、精力与数字基础设施的错误配置，其产出为次优结果。 虽然场景 B 中 TFS 实现的近乎完全恢复表明了在该模型内找回这种已丧失能力的可能性，但这主要说明可持续 AI 必须在设计中明确具备对非对称观测噪声的韧性。

paragraphs.en: The study has four main limitations. First, the learners are synthetic. The observation-noise parameter has now been measured in current graders (Section 4.1 ), but the learning trajectories are simulated in a POMDP environment that excludes instructors, peers, and multimodal assessment. The effect sizes of the control scenario ( Δ = 0.038 \Delta=0.038 at ϵ = 0.05 \epsilon=0.05 , 0.147 0.147 at ϵ = 0.15 \epsilon=0.15 ) therefore describe the autonomous loop in isolation, and their magnitude depends on the coupling parameters of Table 1 ; the robust findings are the qualitative bifurcation, the accelerating harm past ϵ ⋆ \epsilon^{\star} , and the separation of TFS from generic exploration. Second, the observation channel is a stylized construct. It compresses linguistic friction into a scalar false-negative rate, treats the protected group as homogeneous, and ignores intersectionality and false positives; the difficulty-dependent, bursty, and continuous per-learner channels of Section 4.8 relax but do not remove this simplification. Third, the model does not represent modality preferences such as visual, auditory, or hands-on learning. We did not add them because the empirical literature finds no reliable interaction between such preferences and instructional modality [ 36 ] ; learner heterogeneity enters instead through the per-learner friction rate ϵ i \epsilon_{i} and learning rate α i \alpha_{i} , and a modality-aware content generator would add state to the policy without altering the estimator–policy loop. Fourth, TFS is strikingly effective because a passed probe immediately reveals the learner’s demonstrated level and a failed probe is costless. Conditions (C1)–(C4) of Section 3.4 state when this can be expected to hold, and Section 4.9 shows that frustration and entrenchment after failed probes erode but do not eliminate the benefit; probe frequency, placement, and framing would need to be designed with these side effects in mind. Future work should validate the mechanism by mapping linguistic markers to longitudinal curriculum velocity in anonymized logs from deployed adaptive platforms (such as EdNet or ASSISTments) and by measuring ϵ \epsilon on independently annotated banks that span dialects, subjects, and response lengths.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究存在四个主要局限。 首先，学习者是合成的。 观测噪声参数现已在现有评分系统中得到测量（4.1 节），但学习轨迹是在一个排除教师、同伴和多模态评估的 POMDP 环境中模拟的。 因此，对照情景的效应量（Δ = 0.038 \Delta=0.038 于 ϵ = 0.05 \epsilon=0.05，0.147 0.147 于 ϵ = 0.15 \epsilon=0.15）描述的是孤立运行的自主干回路，其大小取决于表 1 的耦合参数；稳健的结论是定性分叉、越过 ϵ ⋆ \epsilon^{\star} 后加速的损害，以及 TFS 相对于一般探索的分离。 其次，观测信道是一个风格化的构造。 它将语言摩擦压缩为一个标量假阴性率，把受保护群体视为同质的，并忽略了交叉性与假阳性；4.8 节中依难度而变、突发且连续的逐学习者信道放松了但没有消除这一简化。 第三，该模型没有表征诸如视觉型、听觉型或动手型学习等模态偏好。 我们没有加入它们，是因为实证文献未发现此类偏好与教学模态之间存在可靠交互 [ 36 ]；学习者异质性转而通过逐学习者摩擦率 ϵ i \epsilon_{i} 和学习率 α i \alpha_{i} 进入模型，而具备模态感知的内容生成器只会给策略增加状态，不会改变估计器—策略回路。 第四，TFS 之所以格外有效，是因为通过探针立即揭示学习者的已证明水平，而未通过探针则没有成本。 3.4 节的条件 (C1)–(C4) 阐明了何时可以预期这一点成立，4.9 节表明失败探针后的挫败与固着会削弱但不会消除该收益；探针的频率、位置与表述方式需要结合这些副作用来设计。 未来工作应通过在已部署自适应平台（如 EdNet 或 ASSISTments）的匿名日志中把语言标记映射到纵向课程速度，并在覆盖方言、学科与回答长度的独立标注题库上测量 ϵ \epsilon，来验证该机制。

paragraphs.en: The recommendations in this subsection are conditional on the mechanism operating in deployed systems as it does in the model (Section 5.1 ); they describe what institutions could do if it does, not what the present evidence shows they must do. The finding that standard optimization in GenAI can construct feedback loops of inequality suggests a need to update how higher education institutions govern EdTech. Current procurement frameworks predominantly rely on static auditing —evaluating a model’s training data or decision boundaries prior to deployment. Our theoretical framework shows that a model fair at initialization ( t = 0 t=0 ) can degenerate into biased behavior through sustained interaction ( t = n t=n ).
paragraphs.zh: 本小节中的建议以机制在部署系统中如其在模型中那样运作（见5.1节）为前提；这些建议描述的是如果机制如此运作，机构可以做什么，而非现有证据表明它们必须做什么。 生成式人工智能（GenAI）中的标准优化能够构建不平等反馈循环这一发现表明，需要更新高等教育机构对教育技术（EdTech）的治理方式。 目前的采购框架主要依赖静态审计——在部署之前评估模型的训练数据或决策边界。 我们的理论框架表明，在初始化时（t=0）公平的模型可能通过持续交互（t=n）退化为有偏的行为。

paragraphs.en: To support the equitable deployment of AI-integrated learning environments, we propose a multi-layered framework for institutional adaptation:
paragraphs.zh: 为支持公平部署融合AI的学习环境，我们提出一个多层次的机构适应框架：

paragraphs.en: Institutions should consider requiring vendors to provide evidence of temporal stability rather than relying solely on static accuracy metrics. Requests for proposals for adaptive learning systems could mandate longitudinal impact statements that simulate the trajectory of diverse learner profiles over extended periods, utilizing dynamic metrics such as the drift divergence defined in this study.
paragraphs.zh: 机构应考虑要求供应商提供时间稳定性的证据，而不是仅仅依赖静态的准确性指标。 自适应学习系统的招标书可以要求提交纵向影响说明，利用本研究定义的漂移散度等动态指标，模拟多样化学习者画像在较长周期内的发展轨迹。

sents.en: Institutions should consider requiring vendors to provide evidence of temporal stability rather than relying solely on static accuracy metrics.
sents.zh: 机构应考虑要求供应商提供时间稳定性的证据，而不是仅仅依赖静态的准确性指标。

sents.en: Requests for proposals for adaptive learning systems could mandate longitudinal impact statements that simulate the trajectory of diverse learner profiles over extended periods, utilizing dynamic metrics such as the drift divergence defined in this study.
sents.zh: 自适应学习系统的招标书可以要求提交纵向影响说明，利用本研究定义的漂移散度等动态指标，模拟多样化学习者画像在较长周期内的发展轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Unlike generic RL exploration such as ϵ \epsilon -greedy methods which optimize for average global reward, adaptive educational systems require targeted fairness corrections for asymmetric demographic noise. Institutions should advocate for technical standards that require generative-adaptive systems to include “pessimism breakers” similar to our TFS. These mechanisms help ensure that learners are not permanently relegated to a remedial track without periodic opportunities to demonstrate latent capability.
paragraphs.zh: 与诸如 ϵ \epsilon -贪婪方法这类以平均全局奖励为优化目标的通用强化学习探索不同，自适应教育系统需要针对非对称性人口噪声进行有针对性的公平性校正。 教育机构应倡导制定技术标准，要求生成式自适应系统包含类似于我们 TFS 的「悲观破解器」。 这些机制有助于确保学习者不会在没有周期性机会展示潜在能力的情况下被永久地归入补救性学习路径。

sents.en: These mechanisms help ensure that learners are not permanently relegated to a remedial track without periodic opportunities to demonstrate latent capability.
sents.zh: 这些机制有助于确保学习者不会在没有周期性机会展示潜在能力的情况下被永久地归入补救性学习路径。

paragraphs.en: As AI assumes a larger role in content generation, the human instructor’s role must evolve toward algorithmic oversight. Learning management systems should be redesigned to visualize potential algorithmic drift. Instead of simply reporting a low mastery score, dashboards could flag instances where a student’s performance history conflicts with the AI’s predictive confidence, enabling instructors to intervene precisely when human-in-the-loop context is needed to correct a system’s spurious deficit [ 22 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 随着人工智能在内容生成中扮演越来越重要的角色，人类教师的角色必须向算法监督方向演进。 学习管理系统应当被重新设计，以使潜在的算法漂移可视化。 仪表盘可以不再仅仅报告一个较低的能力掌握分数，而是标记出学生的历史表现与人工智能的预测置信度相冲突的情况，从而让教师能够在需要「人在回路」情境来纠正系统虚假的能力缺陷时进行精准干预 [ 22 ] 。

paragraphs.en: To align with UN SDG 4, institutions may establish centralized oversight bodies to monitor aggregate learning trajectories. By analyzing anonymized progression data, universities can detect if specific demographic groups systematically experience lower curriculum velocity despite passing grades. Such patterns would indicate that the adaptive infrastructure might be optimizing for engagement or easy completions rather than cognitive growth, signaling a need for systemic recalibration.
paragraphs.zh: 为与联合国可持续发展目标4保持一致，各院校可设立集中监督机构，以监测总体学习轨迹。 通过分析匿名化的学业进展数据，大学可以检测出特定人口群体是否尽管成绩及格，却系统性地经历较低的课业推进速度。 这类模式将表明自适应基础设施可能是在为参与度或轻松完成而优化，而非为认知成长而优化，这意味着需要进行系统性重新校准。

paragraphs.en: By embedding these regenerative mechanisms and governance protocols into the institutional architecture, higher education can better ensure that the adoption of GenAI supports the long-term sustainability of the learning ecosystem, fostering an environment where technological efficiency computationally supports equitable student outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 通过将这些再生机制和治理规程嵌入制度架构中，高等教育能够更好地确保生成式人工智能（GenAI）的采纳有助于学习生态系统的长期可持续性，营造一种技术效率在计算层面上支持公平学生成果的环境。

paragraphs.en: The intervention proposed here addresses algorithmic drift at the level of the adaptive policy, but sustaining fairness and educational effectiveness over time depends on more than algorithmic optimization. Higher education has absorbed successive waves of technology, from personal computing to online learning, without displacing its core purpose of developing knowledge, critical thinking, and graduate capability. Adaptive AI is best understood in the same terms: a tool that augments rather than replaces educator expertise and professional judgment. Realizing this in practice requires institutional investment in people alongside technical mechanisms such as the TFS. Strengthening AI literacy, supporting faculty development, and reconsidering assessment design keep human oversight available to interpret AI-generated recommendations, to weigh contextual factors that the model does not observe, and to keep educational decisions aligned with institutional values and learner needs, consistent with emerging work on responsible AI implementation in higher education [ 21 , 20 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出的干预措施在自适应策略层面应对算法漂移问题，但要长期维持公平性和教育有效性，仅靠算法优化是不够的。 高等教育已经吸收了从个人计算到在线学习的一波又一波技术浪潮，却从未偏离其培养知识、批判性思维和毕业生能力的核心宗旨。 自适应AI最好也在同样的意义上加以理解：它是一种增强而非取代教育者专业知识和专业判断的工具。 要在实践中实现这一点，除了TFS等技术机制之外，还需要机构对人的投入。 加强AI素养、支持教师发展以及重新审视评估设计，能够确保人类监督始终可用，以解读AI生成的建议、权衡模型无法观察到的情境因素，并使教育决策与机构价值观和学习者需求保持一致，这与高等教育中负责任AI实施的最新研究一致 [ 21 , 20 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The phenomenon also carries a reflexive institutional implication. If adaptive systems require continuous monitoring to remain fair, the institutions that deploy them plausibly require a similarly ongoing approach to evaluating their own AI-enabled practices, treating adaptive AI as part of a continuous cycle of institutional learning rather than a one-time implementation. The longitudinal data these systems generate can complement existing evidence on teaching, curriculum effectiveness, assessment, and student progression, supporting more evidence-informed institutional decision-making [ 16 ] . Such evidence should complement rather than replace professional academic judgment and engagement with students and staff. Framed this way, the significance of algorithmic drift extends beyond its computational statement: the same principle of continuous adaptation that stabilizes the learner–tutor dyad may encourage institutions to adopt more reflective, evidence-informed approaches to implementing and evaluating AI, contributing to its responsible and sustainable adoption in higher education [ 6 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这一现象还蕴含着一层反身性的制度意涵。 如果自适应系统需要持续的监测才能保持公平，那么部署这些系统的机构也理应对自身的 AI 赋能实践采取类似的持续评估方式，把自适应 AI 视为机构持续学习循环的一部分，而不是一次性的实施项目。 这些系统生成的纵向数据可以补充有关教学、课程有效性、评估以及学生学业进程的现有证据，支持更具证据依据的机构决策 [ 16 ] 。 此类证据应当是对专业学术判断以及与师生互动的补充，而非替代。 以这种方式来看，算法漂移的意义超越了其计算层面的表述：正是稳定学习者—辅导者互动关系的那种持续适应原则，也可能促使机构在实施和评估 AI 时采取更具反思性、更有证据依据的方法，从而有助于 AI 在高等教育中负责任且可持续地落地 [ 6 ] 。

sents.en: The phenomenon also carries a reflexive institutional implication.
sents.zh: 这一现象还蕴含着一层反身性的制度意涵。

sents.en: If adaptive systems require continuous monitoring to remain fair, the institutions that deploy them plausibly require a similarly ongoing approach to evaluating their own AI-enabled practices, treating adaptive AI as part of a continuous cycle of institutional learning rather than a one-time implementation.

sents.en: The longitudinal data these systems generate can complement existing evidence on teaching, curriculum effectiveness, assessment, and student progression, supporting more evidence-informed institutional decision-making [ 16 ] .
sents.zh: 这些系统生成的纵向数据可以补充有关教学、课程有效性、评估以及学生学业进程的现有证据，支持更具证据依据的机构决策 [ 16 ] 。

sents.en: Such evidence should complement rather than replace professional academic judgment and engagement with students and staff.
sents.zh: 此类证据应当是对专业学术判断以及与师生互动的补充，而非替代。

sents.en: Framed this way, the significance of algorithmic drift extends beyond its computational statement: the same principle of continuous adaptation that stabilizes the learner–tutor dyad may encourage institutions to adopt more reflective, evidence-informed approaches to implementing and evaluating AI, contributing to its responsible and sustainable adoption in higher education [ 6 ] .
sents.zh: 以这种方式来看，算法漂移的意义超越了其计算层面的表述：正是稳定学习者—辅导者互动关系的那种持续适应原则，也可能促使机构在实施和评估 AI 时采取更具反思性、更有证据依据的方法，从而有助于 AI 在高等教育中负责任且可持续地落地 [ 6 ] 。

paragraphs.en: This study elucidates a potential vulnerability in the deployment of GenAI for education: the tendency of adaptive systems to automate the stratification of learners through feedback loops of algorithmic drift. By moving beyond static bias audits and modeling the longitudinal dynamics of the learner–tutor dyad, we showed analytically and in simulation that algorithms optimizing for the learner can transform minor observation noise such as linguistic friction into systemic deficits, and we measured the triggering asymmetry in current foundation-model graders. Within the modeled assumptions, the results support the conclusion that without active regularization, GenAI tutors risk creating self-fulfilling prophecies that artificially cap the human capital development of marginalized populations; whether and how strongly the loop operates in deployed platforms remains to be established with real learner data. However, our findings also offer a blueprint for resilience. The success of the TFS in simulation indicates that these feedback loops are not inevitable. By embedding rights to exploration into the algorithmic architecture and ensuring that epistemic uncertainty triggers a re-verification of learner capability rather than a retreat to remedial content, we can decouple observation noise from curriculum generation. As higher education transitions toward the segment of one, the definition of algorithmic fairness must evolve from a static checkbox at deployment to a continuous, regenerative process. Ultimately, realizing the promise of SDG 4 in the age of AI requires systems that are not only computationally efficient but engineered to be robust guardians of student potential over the long range.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究阐明了生成式人工智能在教育部署中的一个潜在脆弱性：自适应系统倾向于通过算法漂移的反馈回路将学习者分层自动化。 通过超越静态偏见审计并对学习者—导师二元组的纵向动态进行建模，我们在分析和仿真中表明，为学习者优化的算法能够将诸如语言摩擦等微小的观察噪声转化为系统性缺陷，并且我们测量了当前基础模型评分器中的触发不对称性。 在所建模的假设范围内，研究结果支持如下结论：若缺乏主动的正则化，生成式人工智能导师有制造自我实现预言的风险，从而人为地限制边缘化群体的人力资本发展；这一回路在已部署平台上是否运作以及运作强度如何，仍有待用真实学习者数据加以确证。 然而，我们的发现也提供了一份韧性蓝图。 探索性反馈策略（TFS）在仿真中的成功表明，这些反馈回路并非不可避免。 通过将探索权利嵌入算法架构之中，并确保认知上的不确定性触发对学习者能力的重新验证而非退回补救性内容，我们可以将观察噪声与课程生成解耦。 随着高等教育迈向“一人细分”时代，算法公平的定义必须从部署时的静态勾选项演变为一个持续的、可再生的过程。 归根结底，要在人工智能时代实现可持续发展目标 4 的愿景，所需的系统不仅要计算高效，更要被设计成长期范围内学生潜力的坚实守护者。
